report: Lahore's smog, source by source: what satellites can see, and what they can't

evidence.claim: Lahore above Pakistan's legal PM2.5 limit on all 31 days of October 2026; average 100.1 µg/m³ across 26 monitors; weather alone cut PM2.5 about 19% vs October 2025
evidence.source: PAQI analysis as reported by ProPakistani, 2 Nov 2026

evidence.claim: Lahore AQI reported at 448 (2 Nov) and over 500 (1-2 Nov)
Mean October 10 m wind speed at Lahore (m/s)
evidence.source: ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo archive API, hourly, 31.55 N 74.34 E

evidence.claim: Fire spots per day (all satellites) in the frame 30.0-32.6 N, 72.4-75.9 E
Crop-labelled fire spots within 40 km of central Lahore, 15 Oct-1 Nov 2026, all satellites
Crop-labelled fire spots within 100 km of central Lahore, 15 Oct-1 Nov 2026
Tropospheric NO2, mean of 15 Oct-1 Nov, Lahore box 31.40-31.65 N 74.20-74.45 E vs farmland box 31.0-31.3 N 73.8-74.1 E
evidence.source: Copernicus Sentinel-5P TROPOMI via NASA GIBS (TROPOMI_L2_Nitrogen_Dioxide_Tropospheric_Column), processed by HamariHawa
evidence.caveat: 2024 and 2025 tiles are processed differently (full coverage every day); values read back from colour bands

evidence.claim: HamariHawa NO2 hotspots 18-31 Oct 2026 (ratio to surroundings): Rawalpindi 6.49, Karachi 6.14, Lahore NW 31.625,74.235 4.81, Lahore south-centre 31.494,74.344 4.71
Brick kilns within 25 / 50 km of central Lahore, Pakistani side
evidence.source: site/public/sources/kilns.json (SentinelKilnDB CC BY-NC 4.0; Brick Kiln Dataset for Pakistan's IGP Region CC BY 4.0)

evidence.claim: Within 50 km: 7 oil/gas power plants (Bhikki 1,230.9 MW, Sapphire 235, Halmore 225, Atlas 213.9, Saba 134, Kohinoor 131.4, Reshma) and 215 OSM industrial areas
Closed 2016; 14 million tonnes on about 41 acres; capped, vent pipes installed; gas to be sold or flared; Lakhodair takes about 5,000 t/day
evidence.source: BBC Urdu, Umar Draz Nangiana, 24 Mar 2025

evidence.claim: NASA fire detections within 450 m of the Mehmood Booti mound centre (31.6104, 74.3847), archived Oct-Nov season days

Sentinel-2 clear passes (cloud <15%) Oct 2024-Nov 2026 over the Lakhodair dump surface (31.619-31.636 N, 74.413-74.424 E): 86; passes with any pixel B12>0.45: 5; the two large ones (21 Aug 2025, 8 Oct 2026) were clouds on inspection; the others 2-10 pixels
evidence.source: Earth Search Sentinel-2 L2A COGs, processed by HamariHawa

evidence.claim: Lakhodair methane 1,559 kg/h; 19 plumes; persistence 92%; first 2023-06-10, last 2026-03-22. No Carbon Mapper methane record for Mehmood Booti
CAMS modelled dust >= 50 µg/m³ at Lahore on 9 days in Oct 2026 (1-3, 7-11, 30 Oct); dust 43% of modelled PM10 over the month; modelled PM2.5 on dusty days 65 vs 70 µg/m³ on other days
evidence.source: Copernicus CAMS global via Open-Meteo air-quality API, 31.55 N 74.34 E

evidence.claim: Urban Unit 2023 inventory: transport about 83% of Lahore's total emissions (noted possible overestimate). PAQI national study: transport 35%, heavy industry 28%, brick kilns 17%; rejected by Punjab EPD
